# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Defender Ransomware Protection

Blocks an infected device from encrypting files on other machines over the network.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | All Devices |
| Source | IntuneAdmin/IntuneBaselines — Microsoft Endpoint Security, Remote Encryption Protection; values verified against the settings catalog definitions. IntuneAdmin sets Audit; here it is Block. |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Defender_Ransomware_Protection.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Defender_Ransomware_Protection.json) |

> The aggressiveness is set to Low: only block when Defender is 100 percent certain. That is the value with the smallest chance of a false positive, and a false positive is expensive here — you then block a legitimate process that updates files on a share, for example a backup or a sync tool. Medium and High block from 99 and 90 percent certainty respectively; only consider those once reporting shows that nothing legitimate is hit. IntuneAdmin ships this setting on Audit; here it is Block, because detecting without blocking does not stop encryption.
